Heatwaves Impact Europe and US, Sparking Health Concerns and Political Fallout

Several European nations and parts of the US are experiencing severe heatwaves, leading to a significant number of heat-related deaths, particularly in Spain and France. The extreme temperatures are prompting discussions about climate change adaptation and have even led to political consequences in France. Hospitals are preparing for further heat waves, drawing lessons from recent events.
